about: The box release every new server installs (SEC-INSTALL-001). `commit` is the exact 40-hex source commit the signed artifact was built from, never a branch or tag; `sequence` is the manifest sequence a box must not go below. `scripts/gen-box-release.mjs --write` copies this, release/box-artifact-trust.json and release/security-floor.json into the generated constants the apps, the web builder and the Studios compile in; `--check` (and the test suite) fails on drift. Set it in the release run, after the artifact and its signed manifest are published. `newBoxStack` ("arch-v2": Podman and the Rust keyd/broker/core; "classic": Docker and the TS path) is what new servers are built on; the release gym decides it (scripts/release.sh, step 6). `appBrowser` is whether boxes turn the policed app browser on (SEC-BROWSER-002): it ships on only if the release gym's browser-grants group proves it; otherwise the gym step sets it false (scripts/set-app-browser.mjs).
